title: AI-Driven Fair Price Intelligence Platform
description: MSc dissertation project. Engineered an end-to-end platform using Multi-Layer Perceptrons and unsupervised clustering to estimate fair market values and flag pricing anomalies. Built a high-performance FastAPI REST API and a React.js dashboard on a decoupled architecture, deployed securely on AWS.

title: E-commerce Platform
description: Full-stack e-commerce application covering product listings, authentication and order management. Designed the relational database schema, integrated Spring Data JPA, and applied Repository, Service and DTO design patterns to keep the codebase modular and testable.

title: Pizza Order App
description: A responsive pizza ordering interface with real-time form validation and toast notifications. Handles asynchronous API requests and dynamic order summaries with date-fns formatting.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: This site — a personal portfolio built with React, React Router and Tailwind CSS, featuring a categorised skills matrix, work experience timeline and dark mode.
